name: migrationbridge-workspace
description: Root orchestration for the whole branch build - webpack bundles backend/, then each frontend runs its own real builder (Vite for React, Angular CLI/esbuild for Angular). See ARCHITECTURE.txt for why full JS Module Federation isn't used across these three different bundlers.

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend-react run build && cd frontend-angular && npx ng build && cd ..
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend-react test && cd frontend-angular && npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless && cd ..
